content:
Kang froze in mid-stride. His optic sensor dilated, spinning in a fatal division-by-zero loop.

*"Error... anomaly... trajectory non-computable..."* Kang's synthetic vocalizer sputtered, spitting blue static.

*"That's Qi, scrap heap,"* Jin whispered into his ear. *"The breath that hasn't been drawn yet."*
critique: Sanderson: Strong biological limits and mechanical vector precision.
